senses.zh: sự lái xe; cách lái xe
senses.en: the activity of controlling a car or another road vehicle

senses.zh: thúc đẩy; có tác dụng thúc đẩy
senses.en: strongly influencing something and making it happen
blown hard by strong winds

ex.en: Her careful driving made the mountain journey feel safe.
Technological innovation is a driving force behind economic growth, although its benefits are not always shared equally.

col: driving force｜động lực; lực thúc đẩy
tip: driving force nghĩa là động lực, lực thúc đẩy; driving cũng có thể là dạng V-ing của drive.

senses.en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer

senses.zh: phím đàn; đàn phím điện tử
senses.en: A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys

ex.en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.

col: play the keyboard｜chơi đàn phím điện tử
tip: Bàn phím máy tính thường nói a keyboard; chơi nhạc cụ có phím dùng play the keyboard.

senses.en: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or other furniture

ex.en: I keep spare keys in the top kitchen drawer.
Office desks with lockable drawers help employees store personal belongings securely in shared working environments.

col: desk drawer｜ngăn kéo bàn làm việc
tip: Ngăn kéo là drawer; tủ quần áo là wardrobe.

senses.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products
a small object used to remove pencil marks

ex.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.

col: rubber band｜dây thun; dây cao su
tip: Nghĩa “cao su” không đếm được; nghĩa “cục tẩy” đếm được, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng eraser.

senses.en: To combine different substances or things.
A combination of different substances, people, or things.
To spend time socially with other people.

ex.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.

col: mix with others｜giao du với người khác
a diverse mix｜sự kết hợp đa dạng
mix things up｜làm xáo trộn mọi thứ
tip: mix A with B nghĩa là trộn A với B; mix A up with B nghĩa là nhầm lẫn A với B.

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.

col: an electricity bill｜hóa đơn tiền điện
tip: electricity là danh từ không đếm được; electric thường chỉ thứ chạy bằng điện, electrical chỉ thứ liên quan đến điện.

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.

col: launch a product｜tung ra sản phẩm
the product of｜sản phẩm của; kết quả của
tip: product là sản phẩm hoặc kết quả, còn production là quá trình sản xuất.

senses.en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes

ex.en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.

col: a herd of zebras｜một đàn ngựa vằn
zebra crossing｜vạch kẻ đường cho người đi bộ
tip: zebra crossing là cách nói của tiếng Anh Anh để chỉ vạch kẻ đường cho người đi bộ.

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

ex.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.

col: a bottle of shampoo｜một chai dầu gội
tip: Khi nói chung, shampoo thường không đếm được; muốn nói “một chai” dùng a bottle of shampoo.

senses.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

ex.en: We wore safety goggles while mixing liquids in the lab.
A well-equipped school lab allows students to test scientific ideas through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.

col: science lab｜phòng thí nghiệm khoa học
lab equipment｜thiết bị phòng thí nghiệm
lab technician｜kỹ thuật viên phòng thí nghiệm
tip: lab là dạng viết tắt thông dụng của laboratory; cả hai đều là danh từ đếm được.

senses.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.

col: surprised at the result｜ngạc nhiên trước kết quả
surprised to hear｜ngạc nhiên khi nghe
tip: surprised mô tả cảm giác của người; surprising mô tả sự việc gây ngạc nhiên.

senses.en: a device that heats air, water, or another substance

ex.en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.

tip: heater là thiết bị; heating chỉ việc sưởi ấm hoặc hệ thống sưởi.

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.

col: consult a lawyer｜tham khảo ý kiến luật sư
tip: lawyer là từ chung chỉ luật sư, khác với judge (thẩm phán).

senses.en: a place where people buy goods
to keep something somewhere for future use

senses.zh: kho dự trữ; lượng dự trữ
senses.en: a supply of something kept for future use

ex.en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.

col: a store of knowledge｜kho kiến thức
tip: Tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng store cho “cửa hàng”, tiếng Anh Anh hằng ngày hay dùng shop hơn.

senses.en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle.
The circular control used to steer a vehicle.
To move something along on its wheels.

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.

col: behind the wheel｜đang lái xe; nắm quyền điều khiển
tip: at the wheel hoặc behind the wheel thường diễn tả đang lái xe.

senses.zh: một món đồ; một mặt hàng
senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.

senses.zh: mục; hạng mục; một tin tức
senses.en: One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.

col: agenda item｜mục trong chương trình nghị sự
tip: item là danh từ đếm được; “một món quần áo” nói là an item of clothing.

senses.zh: nhân viên lễ tân; nhân viên tiếp tân
senses.en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.

ex.en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.

col: work as a receptionist｜làm lễ tân
ask the receptionist｜hỏi nhân viên lễ tân
tip: reception là quầy lễ tân; receptionist là nhân viên lễ tân.

senses.zh: nhân viên bán hàng nam; người chào hàng nam
senses.en: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.

ex.en: The salesman showed us how to fold the bicycle.
A skilled salesman should explain product limitations honestly rather than pressure customers into making unnecessary purchases.

col: a car salesman｜nhân viên bán xe hơi
a travelling salesman｜người bán hàng rong; nhân viên chào hàng lưu động
an experienced salesman｜nhân viên bán hàng giàu kinh nghiệm
tip: salesman chỉ nam giới; khi không muốn nhấn mạnh giới tính, dùng salesperson.

senses.en: extremely good or enjoyable
strange and imaginative, rather than realistic
extremely large in amount or degree

ex.en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.

tip: Nghĩa “tuyệt vời” mang tính khẩu ngữ; trong văn viết trang trọng có thể dùng excellent.

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot

senses.zh: việc quản lý; sự vận hành
senses.en: the work of managing or operating something
flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped

ex.en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.

col: day-to-day running｜việc quản lý hằng ngày
tip: Khi chỉ hoạt động chạy bộ thì không đếm được; the running of nghĩa là việc quản lý, vận hành.

senses.en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall.
An airport area where passengers board a plane.

ex.en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.

tip: gate thường chỉ cổng trên hàng rào hoặc tường; cửa của căn phòng thường dùng door.

senses.zh: tiêu đề; tên sách; tên gọi
senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.

col: win the title｜giành chức vô địch
defend a title｜bảo vệ danh hiệu
tip: title là tiêu đề hoặc tên gọi; topic là chủ đề được thảo luận.

senses.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.

senses.zh: nền tảng trực tuyến; diễn đàn
senses.en: A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.

col: a platform for debate｜diễn đàn để tranh luận
tip: Ở trên sân ga dùng on the platform, không dùng in.

senses.zh: sự đỗ xe; việc đậu xe
senses.en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place.

senses.zh: chỗ đỗ xe; bãi đỗ xe
senses.en: Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.

ex.en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.

tip: Danh từ này thường không đếm được; “một chỗ đỗ xe” nói là a parking space.

senses.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.
To put something back where it was before.

ex.en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.

col: replace A with B｜thay A bằng B
be replaced by｜bị thay thế bởi
tip: replace A with B nghĩa là dùng B thay A; chú ý đừng nhầm chiều.

senses.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.

senses.zh: yard (đơn vị đo chiều dài, khoảng 0,91 m)
senses.en: A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.

ex.en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.

col: a yard of fabric｜một yard vải
tip: Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng yard cho sân vườn quanh nhà; tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng garden.

senses.en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images
a person or business that prints books and other materials

ex.en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.

tip: print là in; printer có thể chỉ máy in hoặc người làm nghề in ấn.

senses.en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose.

senses.zh: hạ cánh; đáp xuống; cho hạ cánh
senses.en: To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground.
To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.

ex.en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.

col: land a job｜kiếm được việc làm
tip: Nghĩa “đất đai” thường không đếm được; land a job nghĩa là giành được một công việc.

senses.en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.

ex.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.

tip: Số nhiều là businessmen; khi không giới hạn giới tính có thể dùng businessperson.

senses.en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
Willing and pleased to do something.

ex.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.

col: glad to hear｜rất vui khi nghe
glad to help｜sẵn lòng giúp đỡ
tip: Thường làm vị ngữ; dùng be glad to do hoặc be glad that + mệnh đề.

senses.en: To give out or reflect light.
To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth.
Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.

col: shine a light on｜rọi đèn vào
a healthy shine｜vẻ bóng khỏe mạnh
tip: Với nghĩa “tỏa sáng”, quá khứ thường là shone; với nghĩa “đánh bóng”, quá khứ là shined.

senses.en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top

ex.en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.

tip: pear đồng âm với pair; “một quả lê” là a pear.

senses.en: A day when you do not have to work.

ex.en: On my day off, I cycled to the lake.
Taking a regular day off allows employees to recover and may improve their performance at work.

col: take a day off｜nghỉ một ngày
have a day off｜có một ngày nghỉ
a day off work｜một ngày nghỉ làm
tip: Số nhiều là days off; xin nghỉ một ngày có thể nói take a day off.

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.

senses.zh: tính hài hước; sự khôi hài
senses.en: The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.

tip: Khi chỉ thể loại hài thì thường không đếm được; “một bộ phim hài” là a comedy.

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.

col: respond immediately｜phản hồi ngay lập tức
tip: Nghĩa liên từ “ngay khi” chủ yếu gặp trong tiếng Anh Anh.

senses.en: an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen

ex.en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.

col: defrost the freezer｜xả đá tủ đông
tip: freezer dùng để cấp đông; fridge chủ yếu dùng để làm lạnh.

senses.en: A bag carried on your back using shoulder straps.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in a rucksack.
Travellers carrying only a rucksack can move more easily between public transport services.

col: hiking rucksack｜ba lô đi bộ đường dài
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng rucksack; từ này không giới hạn chất liệu vải bạt.

senses.zh: bài luận; bài văn ngắn; tiểu luận
senses.en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.

ex.en: I finished my history essay just before dinner.
Writing an essay encourages students to organise their ideas and support arguments with relevant evidence.

col: write an essay｜viết một bài luận
an essay on｜một bài viết về
tip: Danh từ đếm được; “một bài viết về chủ đề nào đó” là an essay on.

senses.en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.

ex.en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
In some rural communities, the local pub provides an important meeting place for residents.

col: a local pub｜quán pub địa phương
a village pub｜quán pub làng quê
tip: pub thường gắn với bối cảnh nước Anh và hay phục vụ đồ ăn; không đồng nghĩa với khách sạn.

senses.en: A child or young person, in informal language.
Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed.
A young goat.

ex.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.

tip: kid mang tính khẩu ngữ; trong bài viết trang trọng nên dùng child cho “đứa trẻ”.

senses.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.
To direct or control a business, team, or activity.
To cope with a situation despite difficulties or limited resources.

ex.en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.

col: manage to do something｜xoay xở làm được việc gì
manage a team｜quản lý một nhóm
manage your time｜quản lý thời gian
manage without help｜tự xoay xở không cần giúp đỡ
tip: manage to do nghĩa là đã làm được, không chỉ là cố gắng.

senses.zh: rạp xiếc; buổi biểu diễn xiếc
senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.

tip: Có thể chỉ đoàn xiếc hoặc buổi diễn; số nhiều là circuses.

senses.en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work

ex.en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.

col: tourist attraction｜điểm tham quan du lịch
tip: tourist thường là danh từ; trong tourist attraction nó bổ nghĩa cho danh từ đứng sau.

senses.en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food

senses.zh: ngã ba đường; chỗ rẽ nhánh
senses.en: A place where a road or path divides
Divide into separate branches or directions

ex.en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.

col: a knife and fork｜một bộ dao nĩa
a fork in the road｜ngã ba đường
tip: Khi đường forks nghĩa là đường rẽ nhánh; a fork in the road là ngã ba đường.

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.

col: a waste of money｜lãng phí tiền bạc
tip: Dùng waste time doing sth, thường không dùng to do.

senses.en: the head of state in a country without a monarch

senses.zh: chủ tịch; tổng giám đốc; hiệu trưởng đại học
senses.en: the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university

ex.en: The president waved to the crowd outside the palace.
The newly elected president promised to improve public healthcare and expand access to affordable education.

col: presidential election｜cuộc bầu cử tổng thống
vice president｜phó tổng thống; phó chủ tịch
tip: Có thể chỉ tổng thống hoặc người đứng đầu một tổ chức; cách dịch cụ thể tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.zh: thợ cắt tóc (chủ yếu cho nam)
senses.en: Someone who cuts men's hair and trims or shaves beards.

ex.en: The barber trimmed my hair before the wedding.
Local businesses, such as a neighbourhood barber, provide essential services and create opportunities for informal social interaction.

col: go to the barber's｜đến tiệm cắt tóc
a barber shop｜tiệm cắt tóc nam
tip: barber chủ yếu cắt tóc và cạo râu cho nam; barber's có thể chỉ tiệm cắt tóc.

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.

col: stay asleep｜ngủ tiếp; giữ giấc ngủ
tip: asleep thường làm vị ngữ; “em bé đang ngủ” nói là a sleeping baby.

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.

tip: reporter thiên về đưa tin, phỏng vấn; journalist có phạm vi rộng hơn.

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.

col: the reigning queen｜nữ hoàng đang trị vì
king and queen｜vua và hoàng hậu
tip: queen có thể chỉ nữ hoàng cai trị đất nước, cũng có thể chỉ vợ của nhà vua.

senses.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.
Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.

ex.en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.

col: a career in teaching｜sự nghiệp giảng dạy
tip: Nghĩa “giảng dạy” không đếm được; nghĩa “giáo lý, học thuyết” thường dùng teachings.

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

ex.en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.

col: the laws of physics｜các định luật vật lý
tip: Dù kết thúc bằng s, đây vẫn là danh từ không đếm được và đi với động từ số ít.

senses.zh: việc trả phòng; thủ tục rời khách sạn
senses.en: The process of paying and leaving a hotel
The latest time guests must leave their hotel rooms

ex.en: We left our bags at reception after check-out.
Flexible check-out times can improve the travel experience for families with young children.

tip: Danh từ cũng được viết là checkout; động từ là check out.

senses.zh: phát triển; lớn lên; bồi dưỡng
senses.en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced

senses.zh: phát triển; nghiên cứu chế tạo
senses.en: to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.

col: develop a habit｜hình thành thói quen
develop new technology｜phát triển công nghệ mới
tip: Có thể là ngoại động từ hoặc nội động từ: develop skills; skills develop.

senses.en: Running slowly and steadily as a form of exercise.

ex.en: She goes jogging around the park before breakfast.
Regular jogging can improve physical fitness, especially when combined with a balanced diet and adequate rest.

tip: Khi jog thành jogging phải gấp đôi chữ g.

senses.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation
Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.

col: prepare for an exam｜chuẩn bị cho kỳ thi
prepare a meal｜chuẩn bị bữa ăn
prepare to leave｜chuẩn bị rời đi
tip: prepare for đi với danh từ; prepare to đi với động từ nguyên mẫu.

senses.zh: thuộc Thụy Sĩ; người Thụy Sĩ
senses.en: Relating to Switzerland, its people, or their culture.
The people of Switzerland, considered as a group.

ex.en: We enjoyed Swiss cheese during our picnic by the lake.
Swiss railways demonstrate how reliable public transport can connect remote mountain communities and support sustainable tourism.

col: Swiss Alps｜dãy Alps của Thụy Sĩ
tip: Phải viết hoa chữ cái đầu; the Swiss chỉ người Thụy Sĩ nói chung, không thêm s.

senses.en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks
to attack someone in public and steal from them

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.

col: a mug of coffee｜một cốc cà phê
tip: mug thường có quai và to; làm động từ có thể nghĩa là cướp giật trên đường.

senses.en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts.

senses.zh: chà nhám; đánh bóng bằng giấy nhám
senses.en: To make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper.

ex.en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.

col: a grain of sand｜một hạt cát
tip: Nghĩa “cát” không đếm được; “một hạt cát” nói là a grain of sand.

senses.en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.

ex.en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.

col: waterproof raincoat｜áo mưa chống thấm nước
put on a raincoat｜mặc áo mưa vào
tip: Cả tiếng Anh Anh lẫn Mỹ đều dùng raincoat, không chỉ riêng tiếng Anh Mỹ.

senses.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.
A book used to record appointments and future plans.

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.

tip: diary là nhật ký, dairy là sản phẩm từ sữa; chú ý thứ tự chữ cái.

senses.en: A motor vehicle with two wheels, usually for one or two.
To travel by motorcycle.

ex.en: He parked his motorcycle beside the garden gate.
Although motorcycles require less parking space than cars, riders are more exposed to injury in road accidents.

col: motorcycle helmet｜mũ bảo hiểm xe máy
tip: “Đi xe máy” dùng ride, thường không dùng drive.

senses.en: to keep something in your hands or arms
to organise an event or meeting
to have enough space for something or someone

ex.en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.

col: hold a meeting｜tổ chức cuộc họp
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là held; “tổ chức cuộc họp” dùng hold.

senses.zh: quầy lễ tân; khu tiếp tân
senses.en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information
a formal social event held to welcome or celebrate someone

senses.zh: chất lượng thu sóng; phản ứng đón nhận
senses.en: how well signals are received, or how people respond

ex.en: Please leave your room key at reception before breakfast.
The proposal received a positive reception from local residents because it addressed their concerns about road safety.

col: warm reception｜sự đón tiếp nồng hậu
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh hay nói at reception, nghĩa là ở quầy lễ tân.

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.

tip: foreign to có thể nghĩa là xa lạ với ai, hoặc không phù hợp với điều gì.

senses.en: the planet where humans and other known living things exist
the loose material on the ground in which plants grow

ex.en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.

tip: Khi chỉ hành tinh thường viết hoa Earth; on earth không dùng the.

senses.zh: gói nhỏ; túi nhỏ; hộp nhỏ
senses.en: A small container or wrapped quantity of something.
A small unit of data transmitted across a network.

ex.en: She opened a packet of biscuits for the journey.
Charging customers for each packet of disposable utensils could encourage more sustainable habits in the food industry.

col: a packet of biscuits｜một gói bánh quy
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng a packet of; tiếng Anh Mỹ tùy vật mà dùng pack hoặc bag.

senses.en: A narrow board with small wheels, ridden standing up.
To move or perform tricks on a skateboard.

ex.en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.

col: skateboard tricks｜các kỹ thuật trượt ván
a skateboard park｜công viên trượt ván
tip: skateboard không có tay cầm; scooter thường có tay cầm.

senses.en: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances

ex.en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.

col: motorway junction｜nút giao đường cao tốc
motorway services｜trạm dừng chân trên cao tốc
join the motorway｜đi vào đường cao tốc
tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng freeway.

senses.zh: thuộc châu Âu; người châu Âu
senses.en: Relating to Europe or its people.
A person from Europe.

ex.en: We explored several European cities during our summer holiday.
Many European countries have invested in railway networks to reduce dependence on short domestic flights.

col: the European Union｜Liên minh châu Âu
tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; đi với a chứ không phải an, và không đồng nghĩa với “thuộc Liên minh châu Âu”.

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.

tip: Nói chung về đau thường không đếm được; một cơn đau cụ thể có thể dùng a pain.

senses.zh: chắc chắn; nhất định; dĩ nhiên
senses.en: certainly, with no doubt about something

ex.en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.

tip: Chú ý cách viết definitely; đừng nhầm với defiantly.

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.

tip: mile là đơn vị đo khoảng cách (khoảng 1,61 km); là danh từ đếm được, số nhiều thêm s.

senses.en: Having a lot of wind.

ex.en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.

col: a windy day｜một ngày gió lớn
tip: Nghĩa thời tiết đọc là /ˈwɪndi/; để tả con đường quanh co thường dùng winding.

senses.zh: ở đâu đó; đến đâu đó
senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.

tip: Tính từ đặt sau: somewhere quiet; phía trước thường không thêm to.

senses.zh: máy tính bỏ túi; công cụ tính toán
senses.en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations

ex.en: I used a calculator to check the shopping total.
Allowing students to use a calculator can help them focus on solving more complex mathematical problems.

tip: calculator là dụng cụ; calculation là quá trình hoặc kết quả tính toán.

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.

col: the surface of the moon｜bề mặt Mặt Trăng
tip: Mặt trăng của Trái Đất thường dùng the moon; vệ tinh của các hành tinh khác là danh từ đếm được.

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned or being described
used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.

col: such problems｜những vấn đề như vậy
tip: Trước danh từ đếm được số ít dùng such a/an; so đi thẳng với tính từ.

senses.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest.
To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm.
A regular pulse of sound or movement.

ex.en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.

col: beat an opponent｜đánh bại đối thủ
tip: Quá khứ là beat, quá khứ phân từ là beaten; thắng một trận đấu dùng win.

senses.en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines

ex.en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.

tip: Danh từ không đếm được; tiếng Anh Anh dùng petrol, tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng gasoline hoặc gas.

senses.en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly

ex.en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.

tip: salary là lương cố định; wages thường là tiền công tính theo giờ hoặc tuần.

senses.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.
The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions.
To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.

ex.en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.

col: a voice in decisions｜tiếng nói trong các quyết định
voice concerns｜bày tỏ mối lo ngại
tip: voice nhấn vào giọng nói của con người; sound chỉ âm thanh nói chung.

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex.en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.

col: crown a king｜đội vương miện cho vua
the king's reign｜triều đại của nhà vua
tip: king chỉ vua nam; queen có thể là nữ hoàng hoặc hoàng hậu.

senses.zh: sự khác biệt; điểm khác nhau
senses.en: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.

col: the difference between｜sự khác nhau giữa
make a difference｜tạo ra sự khác biệt; có ảnh hưởng
a significant difference｜khác biệt đáng kể
tip: So sánh hai thứ dùng the difference between A and B.

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.

col: hope to do something｜hy vọng làm việc gì
hope for the best｜hy vọng điều tốt nhất
give up hope｜từ bỏ hy vọng
in the hope of｜với hy vọng
tip: Có thể nói hope to do, không nói hope sb to do.

senses.zh: hướng dẫn viên; người dẫn đường
senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit

senses.zh: sách hướng dẫn; tài liệu chỉ dẫn
senses.en: a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

ex.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.

col: tour guide｜hướng dẫn viên du lịch
guide someone through｜hướng dẫn ai đó hoàn thành
guided tour｜chuyến tham quan có hướng dẫn viên
tip: “Sách hướng dẫn về” dùng a guide to; hướng dẫn ai hoàn thành việc gì dùng guide someone through.

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.

tip: Khi nói chung về vật liệu thì không đếm được; khi chỉ các loại kim loại thì đếm được.

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.

col: a bowl of soup｜một bát súp
tip: a bowl of nghĩa là “một bát”; bowling là môn bowling.

senses.zh: ngày trong tuần; ngày thường (thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu)
senses.en: any day from Monday to Friday

ex.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.

col: on weekdays｜vào các ngày trong tuần
a weekday service｜chuyến phục vụ ngày thường
tip: Chỉ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu, không đảm bảo rằng hôm đó thực sự phải đi làm.

senses.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.
To support someone financially by supplying what they need.

ex.en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.

col: provide support｜cung cấp sự hỗ trợ
provide access to｜cung cấp quyền truy cập
provide someone with something｜cung cấp cho ai thứ gì
provide for a family｜nuôi gia đình
tip: Dùng provide sb with sth hoặc provide sth for sb.

senses.en: a large building or complex containing many shops

ex.en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.

col: indoor mall｜trung tâm thương mại trong nhà
mall entrance｜lối vào trung tâm thương mại
tip: mall hay dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ; tiếng Anh Anh thường nói shopping centre.

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.

col: halls of residence｜ký túc xá đại học
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh, ký túc xá đại học thường gọi là halls hoặc halls of residence.

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.

col: find something helpful｜thấy cái gì đó hữu ích
tip: helpful có thể mô tả vật hữu ích, cũng có thể mô tả người hay giúp đỡ.

senses.en: A country in the northern part of Great Britain.

ex.en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
Scotland attracts visitors with its dramatic landscapes, while rural communities benefit from spending on accommodation and local services.

col: the west coast of Scotland｜bờ biển phía tây Scotland
a trip to Scotland｜chuyến đi đến Scotland
tip: Scotland là một bộ phận của Vương quốc Anh; tính từ thường dùng là Scottish.

senses.en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants

ex.en: The vet checked our rabbit for signs of disease.
Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.

col: the spread of disease｜sự lây lan của bệnh
tip: Trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai; khi nói chung về bệnh tật có thể không dùng mạo từ.

senses.en: A board displaying announcements for people to read.

ex.en: Someone pinned a lost cat poster to the noticeboard.
A shared noticeboard can help residents discover local events and participate more actively in community life.

col: community noticeboard｜bảng thông báo cộng đồng
on the noticeboard｜trên bảng thông báo
put up a noticeboard｜lắp bảng thông báo
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh hay dùng noticeboard, tiếng Anh Mỹ hay dùng bulletin board.

senses.en: to choose someone or something from available options
to remove fruit or flowers from a plant
a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.

col: pick a winner｜chọn người thắng cuộc
take your pick｜cứ chọn thoải mái
tip: pick có thể là chọn hoặc hái; “nhặt lên” thường dùng pick up.

senses.en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles.
A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.

ex.en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
Converting an unused garage into living space can provide additional accommodation without requiring new land.

col: local garage｜xưởng sửa xe địa phương
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh cũng hay dùng garage để chỉ xưởng sửa xe.

senses.zh: dịch vụ; phục vụ công cộng
senses.en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers.

senses.zh: bảo dưỡng; kiểm tra sửa chữa
senses.en: Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working.
A formal religious ceremony.

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.

tip: Khi nói về chất lượng phục vụ thường không đếm được; các dịch vụ cụ thể dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.

col: a former classmate｜một bạn học cũ
help a classmate｜giúp đỡ bạn cùng lớp
a new classmate｜một bạn cùng lớp mới
tip: classmate là bạn cùng lớp, schoolmate là bạn cùng trường.
